clue.text: Greek characters back another one over process

indicators.note: in an across clue 'over' asks for the preceding letter to be turned back on itself, read right to left

blocks.note: two Greek letters, xi and phi
the stern is the back of a ship
another Greek character, mu

explanation.surface: Someone reads Greek letters backwards and then handles one more in some procedure.
explanation.walkthrough: XI and PHI, then STERN, then MU turned over to UM. The process here is the anatomical kind, a projecting part of bone.
explanation.definitionFit: The xiphisternum is the xiphoid process, the small pointed lowest section of the breastbone.
